subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “A young man played guitar outside the subway station every Friday evening.”?
options: There were coins, toys, photos, bowls, letters, and tools.
Some dropped coins into his case.
Lisa dropped her phone, and the screen cracked.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「There were coins, toys, photos, bowls, letters, and tools.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「'Maybe someone else will need it.'」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Some dropped coins into his case.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Lisa dropped her phone, and the screen cracked.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
